name: Workout API CI exercise
description: Checks the application log for startup and HTTP response coverage.

tests.name: 1. Basic: GET / returns 200
tests.description: Public endpoint returns welcome message

tests.name: 2. Basic: GET /health returns 200
tests.description: Health check endpoint works without authentication

tests.name: 3. Basic: POST /auth/login returns 200
tests.description: Valid login with correct credentials returns token

tests.name: 4. Basic: GET /workouts returns 200
tests.description: Authenticated user can list their workouts

tests.name: 5. Basic: POST /workouts returns 201
tests.description: Creating a workout returns 201 Created with new ID

tests.name: 6. Basic: GET /workouts/{id} returns 200
tests.description: Retrieving a specific workout by ID works

tests.name: 7. Basic: PUT /workouts/{id} returns 200
tests.description: Updating a workout preserves ID and returns updated data

tests.name: 8. Basic: DELETE /workouts/{id} returns 204
tests.description: Deleting a workout returns 204 No Content

tests.name: 9. Basic: Multiple users can authenticate
tests.description: Second user (spaceballs) can log in separately

tests.name: 10. Basic: Empty workout list for new user
tests.description: Newly authenticated user initially sees empty workout list

tests.name: 11. Error: POST /auth/login with wrong password returns 401
tests.description: Invalid credentials are rejected

tests.name: 12. Error: POST /auth/login with missing field returns 400
tests.description: Malformed request (missing password field) returns 400

tests.name: 13. Error: GET /workouts without token returns 401
tests.description: Protected endpoint requires authentication

tests.name: 14. Error: POST /workouts with invalid token returns 401
tests.description: Invalid/malformed token is rejected

tests.name: 15. Error: POST /workouts with empty name returns 400
tests.description: Validation: empty workout name is rejected

tests.name: 16. Error: POST /workouts with invalid duration returns 400
tests.description: Validation: negative or invalid duration is rejected

tests.name: 17. Error: GET /workouts/{nonexistent} returns 404
tests.description: Querying non-existent workout ID returns 404 Not Found

tests.name: 18. Error: PUT /workouts/{nonexistent} returns 404
tests.description: Updating non-existent workout returns 404 Not Found

tests.name: 19. Error: DELETE /workouts/{nonexistent} returns 404
tests.description: Deleting non-existent workout returns 404 Not Found

tests.name: 20. Error: Cross-user permission violation returns 404
tests.description: User cannot access/modify another user's workout (returns 404)
